description: Zonage de l'assainissement - GrandSoissons Agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GrandSoissons Agglomération. Ce jeu de données représente le zonage de l’assainissement sur le territoire de GrandSoissons Agglomération. Les zones en couleur indiquent les secteurs raccordés à l’assainissement collectif, les autres relèvent de l’assainissement individuel. Les données sont issues d’un fond cartographique et peuvent être utilisées pour l’information du public ou l’aménagement du territoire. Coverage: GrandSoissons Agglomération. The publisher named on the listing is GrandSoissons Agglomération. Its keywords include assainissement. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
